title: Move the server to one versioned store
acceptance:
Story: the operator starts the 0.1 server copy and it keeps every account and file across restarts in one shared store instead of a per-version folder.
Expected: the server boots against the shared FoundationOS store under LOCALAPPDATA, honours the FOUNDATIONOS_DATA override for isolated runs, and keeps accounts and homes under that one root.
Not expected: importing or migrating the old 0.1 development data; that fixture store stays untouched.
Depends on: nothing. WI-11 builds its migration runner on this store.
Verify: restart the server in acceptance and confirm both members and their files remain.
evidence: Implemented in versions/0.2 FoundationOS/FoundationOS Server/server.ts: one store under LOCALAPPDATA/FoundationOS/store with a FOUNDATIONOS_DATA override; accounts and homes survive restart (node test keeps data across restarts, verify.py restart step). PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
